s: What fiscal deficit target did Union Budget 2026-27 set for 2026-27?
x: The 2026-27 target is 4.3% of GDP (₹16.95 lakh crore); 4.4% was the 2025-26 figure.

s: On which date was the Economic Survey 2025-26 tabled?
x: It was tabled on 29 January 2026, two days before the Budget.

s: What real GDP growth did the Economic Survey 2025-26 project for FY27?
x: The Survey projected 6.8–7.2% for FY27 and estimated 7.4% for FY26.

s: Who was the Chief Economic Adviser when the Economic Survey 2025-26 was tabled?
x: V. Anantha Nageswaran was the Chief Economic Adviser for the Economic Survey 2025-26.

s: What real GDP growth did the Economic Survey 2025-26 estimate for FY26?
x: The Economic Survey 2025-26 estimated FY26 real GDP growth at 7.4%.

s: To what level is India's debt-to-GDP ratio to fall under Union Budget 2026-27, from 56.1%?
x: Budget 2026-27 projects the debt-to-GDP ratio to fall from 56.1% to 55.6%.

s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much to BioPharma Shakti over 5 years?
x: BioPharma Shakti got ₹10,000 crore over 5 years, not ₹12,000 crore.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 semiconductor and electronics measures?
o: The electronics components manufacturing scheme allocation was raised to ₹30,000 crore
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 includes skill centres
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers indigenous IP and industry-led R&D
India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 covers equipment and raw materials
x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore, not ₹30,000 crore.

s: Which State is among the four identified for Rare Earth corridors in Union Budget 2026–27?
x: The four States are Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

s: Union Budget 2026-27 proposed how many new NIPERs?
x: It proposed 3 new NIPERs and an upgrade of the existing 7.

s: To what amount did Union Budget 2026-27 raise the allocation for the Electronics components manufacturing scheme?
x: The electronics components scheme allocation was raised to ₹40,000 crore.

s: How many speciality chemical parks will the Centre help States set up under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Budget 2026-27 proposes support to States to set up 3 speciality chemical parks.

s: For what are mega textile parks proposed under the textile expansion and employment scheme of Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The scheme proposes mega textile parks for technical textiles; the National Fibre Scheme covers natural, synthetic and advanced fibres.

s: The Union Budget special scheme for legacy industrial clusters aims to rejuvenate how many clusters?
x: The scheme is meant to rejuvenate 200 clusters, not 300.

s: What is the size of the SME Growth Fund announced in Union Budget 2026-27 to create 'champion SMEs'?
x: The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore; the Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore.

s: What is the aim of the National Fibre Scheme announced in Union Budget 2026-27?
o: Self-reliance in natural, synthetic and advanced fibres
x: The National Fibre Scheme aims at self-reliance in natural, synthetic and advanced fibres.

s: Union Budget 2026–27 allocated how much over 5 years for CCUS technologies?
x: The CCUS allocation is ₹20,000 crore over 5 years; the Budget also announced 7 high-speed rail corridors.

s: To what amount did Union Budget 2026-27 raise capital expenditure?
x: Capex was raised to ₹12.2 lakh crore from ₹11.2 lakh crore.

s: What infrastructure-related institution was proposed to be established in Union Budget 2026–27?
x: The Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund was proposed to be established. The other three institutions do not correspond to the announced measure.

s: Which new dedicated freight corridor was proposed in Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The new dedicated freight corridor runs from Dankuni to Surat; the Budget also proposed 20 new National Waterways over 5 years.

s: Which of the following correctly states two transport-related announcements of Union Budget 2026–27?
o: River vessel repair ecosystems at Patna and Kochi; coastal cargo share target of 12% by 2035
River vessel repair ecosystems at Varanasi and Surat; coastal cargo share target of 10% by 2047
River vessel repair ecosystems at Varanasi and Patna; coastal cargo share target of 12% by 2047
River vessel repair ecosystems at Dankuni and Patna; coastal cargo share target of 15% by 2047
x: River vessel repair ecosystems are to be developed at Varanasi and Patna, and the coastal cargo share target is 12% by 2047. The other options change either the locations or the target year and percentage.

s: How many new National Waterways did Union Budget 2026-27 propose over 5 years?
x: It proposed 20 new National Waterways; 7 is the number of high-speed rail corridors.

s: How much did Union Budget 2026-27 provide for each City Economic Region over 5 years?
x: Budget 2026-27 gives ₹5,000 crore over 5 years for each City Economic Region.

s: How many high-speed rail corridors were announced in Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Budget 2026-27 announced 7 high-speed rail corridors.

s: Under Union Budget 2026-27, REITs are to be used to recycle which assets?
x: Budget 2026-27 proposes REITs to recycle the real estate assets of central public sector enterprises.

s: Which two entities are to be restructured under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The Budget proposed restructuring Power Finance Corporation and Rural Electrification Corporation.

s: Under which organisation was UPI launched in 2016?
x: UPI was launched in 2016 under the National Payments Corporation of India.

s: Which of the following pairs (payment platform – launch) is correctly matched?
x: e-RUPI started on 2 August 2021; RuPay dates to 2012 and UPI to 2016.

s: To what level did the RBI cut the repo rate, by 25 bps, in December 2025?
x: The December 2025 cut took the repo to 5.25%, a cumulative 125 bps cut since February 2025.

s: What was the Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate after the RBI policy of 6 February 2026?
x: In February 2026: repo 5.25%, SDF 5.00%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.50%.

s: To what level did the RBI raise its FY26 GDP growth projection in February 2026?
x: The RBI raised its FY26 GDP projection to 7.4% and put FY26 CPI at 2.1%.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Union Budget 2026-27 finance-sector proposals?
o: PFC and REC are to be restructured
An Infrastructure Risk Guarantee Fund will give partial credit guarantees to lenders
The SME Growth Fund is ₹10,000 crore
The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹10,000 crore
x: The Atmanirbhar Bharat Fund gets an additional ₹2,000 crore, not ₹10,000 crore.

s: Where did the Prime Minister launch the Aadhaar-enabled BHIM app for merchants on 14 April 2017?
x: The Aadhaar-enabled BHIM app for merchants was launched at Nagpur on 14 April 2017.

s: In which year was RuPay, the card network of NPCI, launched?
x: RuPay was launched by NPCI in 2012.

s: What was the cumulative repo rate cut by the RBI from February 2025 to December 2025?
x: After the 25 bps cut in December 2025 to 5.25%, cumulative cuts since February 2025 reached 125 bps.

s: Along with NPCI, which bodies helped develop e-RUPI, launched on 2 August 2021?
o: Ministry of Rural Development and SIDBI
Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Health and National Health Authority
x: e-RUPI was developed with the Department of Financial Services, the Ministry of Health and the National Health Authority.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals, from when will the new Income Tax Act come into force?
x: The new Income Tax Act will come into force from April 2026. It will introduce simplified rules and forms designed for common citizens; March 2026 is not the stated commencement period.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals, what is the treatment of interest awarded by a Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to a natural person?
o: It is exempt, and TDS on it is removed
It is taxable, and TDS is increased
It is exempt only for non-residents, and TDS is retained
It is taxed as capital gains, and TDS is removed
x: Interest awarded by a Motor Accident Claims Tribunal to a natural person is exempt, and TDS on it is removed. The tempting capital-gains option is incorrect because the proposal specifically concerns exemption and removal of TDS.

s: To which date does Union Budget 2026-27 extend the deadline for revising an income-tax return, from 31 December?
x: The revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March with a nominal fee.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Budget 2026–27 tax proposals?
o: Updated returns are allowed even after reassessment begins
Such updated returns carry an additional 10% tax
The return-revision deadline moves from 31 December to 31 March
The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme is a one-time, 3-month scheme
x: The Foreign Asset Disclosure Scheme runs for 6 months, not 3 months.

s: How are Forms 15G/15H to be filed under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: Forms 15G/15H get single-window filing through depositories; lower/nil TDS certificates get the rules-based automated process.

s: Under the Union Budget 2026–27 proposal on MAT credit, which companies can use the old credit for set-off?
o: All companies, with set-off capped at one-half
Companies moving to the new regime, with set-off capped at one-fourth
Companies remaining in the old regime, with set-off capped at one-fourth
Companies moving to the new regime, with unlimited set-off
x: The old MAT credit can be set off only by companies moving to the new regime, and the set-off is capped at one-fourth. The alternatives incorrectly change the eligible companies or the cap.

s: What is the STT on options premium and exercise under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: STT on options premium and exercise is 0.15%; STT on futures was raised to 0.05%.

s: To what rate is TCS on LRS remittances for education and medical purposes reduced from 5% under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: TCS on LRS for education and medical purposes is now 2%, the same as on foreign tour packages and tendu leaves.

s: What change did Union Budget 2026-27 make to STT on futures?
x: STT on futures was raised from 0.02% to 0.05%; 0.15% applies to options premium and exercise.

s: How are share buybacks to be taxed under Union Budget 2026-27?
o: As capital gains for all shareholders
As business income of the company
x: Buybacks are to be taxed as capital gains for all shareholders (effective 22% for corporate promoters, 30% for non-corporate promoters).

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer & Analyst Grade-II (A
s:
Select the option that shows the correct chronological order of the following events in India's economy.

A. India's first union budget was presented in Parliament.

B. Indira Gandhi nationalised 14 private banks.

C. Indira Gandhi took the drastic step of devaluing the Indian rupee by a sharp 57%.

D. This budget lowered direct taxes for companies and raised exemption limits for income tax.

E. The dismantling of the licence Raj by the Narasimha Rao-led government.
To what amount did Union Budget 2026-27 raise the safe harbour threshold for IT services, from ₹300 crore?
x: The threshold was raised from ₹300 crore to ₹2,000 crore, with a 15.5% safe harbour margin.

s: What tax concession is proposed for foreign companies providing cloud services to global customers through Indian data centres?
o: A 5-year income-tax exemption only for capital-goods suppliers
A 2% safe harbour margin on invoice value
x: Foreign companies providing cloud services to global customers through Indian data centres are proposed to receive a tax holiday up to 2047. The other options describe separate safe-harbour or bonded-zone measures.

s: Which of the following Union Budget 2026–27 proposals is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Component warehousing in bonded warehouses – 15% safe harbour on costs
Related-entity data centre services – 15% safe harbour on costs
Toll manufacturing in bonded zones – 5-year income-tax exemption for specified suppliers
Non-resident experts – Global income exempt for a 5-year stay under notified schemes
x: Component warehousing uses 2% of invoice value as the safe harbour margin; 15% on costs is for data centre services.

s: What is the safe harbour margin for IT services under Union Budget 2026-27?
x: The IT-services safe harbour margin is 15.5%, with the threshold raised to ₹2,000 crore.

s: Under Union Budget 2026-27, the deduction for cooperative societies was extended to societies supplying which items?
x: The deduction was extended to cooperatives supplying cattle feed and cotton seeds.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's early Budgets?
o: James Wilson presented British India's first Budget on 7 April 1860
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented independent India's first Budget on 26 November 1947
R.K. Shanmukham Chetty presented the first Budget of the Republic
Liaquat Ali Khan presented the 1947-48 Budget of the Interim Government
x: The first Budget of the Republic was presented by John Mathai, not Chetty.

s: Who delivered the longest Union Budget speech by words (18,650 words)?
x: Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech was the longest by words; Sitharaman's 2020 speech was the longest by time (2 h 42 min).

s: Who was the first woman to present the Union Budget (1970-71)?
x: Indira Gandhi, while also Prime Minister, presented the 1970-71 Budget.

s: Who presented the shortest Union Budget, of about 800 words, in 1977?
x: H.M. Patel presented the shortest Budget in 1977, of about 800 words.

s: Who moved the Union Budget presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM?
x: Yashwant Sinha shifted the presentation time from 5 PM to 11 AM.

s: Where did Budget printing shift from Rashtrapati Bhavan after the 1950 Budget leak?
x: Printing moved to Minto Road after the 1950 leak and to the North Block basement from 1980.

s: In which year did Nirmala Sitharaman replace the Budget briefcase with the Bahi-Khata?
x: The Bahi-Khata replaced the briefcase in 2019.

s: On which occasion did Morarji Desai present the Budget in 1964 and 1968?
o: On the last working day of February
On 1 February, the first Budget day
x: Morarji Desai presented the Budget on 29 February, his birthday, in 1964 and 1968. The other options refer to different Budget traditions or dates and do not describe those two presentations.

s: Who has presented the most Union Budgets (10)?
x: Morarji Desai presented 10 Budgets; Sitharaman and Chidambaram have 9 each.

s: Who moved the Budget date to 1 February and merged the Railway Budget in 2017?
x: Arun Jaitley did both in 2017; Yashwant Sinha changed the time to 11 AM in 1999.

s: Which of the following pairs (Budget record – holder) is correctly matched?
o: Longest speech by time – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Longest speech by words – Nirmala Sitharaman (2020)
Most Budgets by a woman FM – Indira Gandhi
x: Sitharaman's 2020 speech (2 h 42 min) is the longest by time; Manmohan Singh's 1991 speech is longest by words.

s: When was the first paperless Union Budget presented?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman presented the first paperless Budget on 1 February 2021.

s: In which year did the separate Railway Budget begin?
x: A separate Railway Budget began in 1924; it was merged with the Union Budget in 2017.

s: Who presented the first Budget of the Republic of India?
x: John Mathai presented the first Budget of the Republic; Shanmukham Chetty presented independent India's first Budget.

s: Who has presented the most Union Budgets as a woman Finance Minister?
x: Nirmala Sitharaman has presented 9 Budgets, the most by a woman Finance Minister.

s: Which of the following Prime Ministers presented a Union Budget?
o: Jawaharlal Nehru, Charan Singh and Rajiv Gandhi
Lal Bahadur Shastri, Morarji Desai and V.P. Singh
Indira Gandhi, Narasimha Rao and Manmohan Singh
Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi
x: Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi presented Budgets while Prime Minister.

s: Where is the Halwa ceremony, which marks the start of Budget printing, held?
x: The Halwa ceremony is held on the ground floor of North Block about 10 days before the Budget.

s: On which date did PM Narendra Modi announce the demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes?
x: It was announced on the evening of 8 November 2016; the notes ceased to be legal tender from midnight.

s:
Consider the following statements about the GST rollout:
1. GST was launched at midnight of 1 July 2017 in the Central Hall of Parliament.
2. It was based on the 101st Constitutional Amendment.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: GST was rolled out at midnight of 1 July 2017 with President Pranab Mukherjee, under the 101st Amendment.

s: The revised Index of Core Industries (July 2026) uses base year 2022-23 and adds which ninth industry?
x: The OEA, DPIIT added iron ore as the ninth core industry in the 2022-23 series.

s: Who releases the monthly PLFS bulletin?
x: MoSPI releases the PLFS monthly bulletin; the first, for April 2025, came out on 15 May 2025.

s: Which small-savings rate stood at 8.2% for October–December 2025?
x: Sukanya Samriddhi was at 8.2%, NSC 7.7% and PPF 7.1%.

s: What was the EPF interest rate for 2024-25?
x: EPF interest for 2024-25 was 8.25%.

s: Demonetization was implemented in which year?
x: Demonetization of the ' 500 and ' 1000 currency notes was announced and implemented by the Government of India on 8th November 2016, aimed at curbing black money, counterfeit currency and promoting digital payments.

s: The RBI issues banknotes under which Section of the RBI Act?
x: Banknotes are issued by the RBI under Section 22 of the RBI Act, while coins are issued by the Government of India under the Coinage Act, 2011.

s: On which date did the Government of India announce the demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes?
x: The Government announced demonetisation of the ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes on 8 November 2016.

s: Who issues coins in India under the Coinage Act, 2011?
x: Coins are issued by the Government of India; banknotes by the RBI under Section 22 of the RBI Act.

s: Which of the following was NOT an aim of demonetisation in 2016?
x: Demonetisation aimed at black money, counterfeit notes and digital payments; GST came only in 2017.

s:
In connection with the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF), which of the following statement / statements is / are valid?
I. The fund will be established through reserved bonds taken from the G-Sec market.
II. The fund is to be exclusively availed by private agencies to create urban infrastructure in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
III. Eligible activities for UIDF shall be connected to the Missions and Programmes of the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MOHUA).
IV. The fund will be collectively managed by a cluster of Municipal Cooperative Banks. 82.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
x: The Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) was announced to support infrastructure development in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. The fund supports projects aligned with programmes of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, such as urban transport and water supply.

s: Which body runs the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities?
x: UIDF, announced in Budget 2023-24, is funded from the PSL shortfall and run by the National Housing Bank, not NABARD.

s: India's current account deficit in 2025-26 was what percentage of GDP?
x: India's CAD was 1.1% of GDP in 2025-26.

s: From which source is the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF) funded?
x: UIDF draws on the Priority Sector Lending shortfall and is run by the National Housing Bank.

s: In which Union Budget was the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund announced?
x: UIDF was announced in Union Budget 2023-24 for Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

s: Who was the Chief Economic Adviser for the Economic Survey 2025-26?
x: V. Anantha Nageswaran is the CEA; the Survey was tabled on 29 January 2026.

s: What is the annual size of the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF)?
x: The UIDF is ₹10,000 crore a year, ₹30,000 crore in total for FY24-FY26.

s: About how much had Andhra Pradesh taken from the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund by August 2026?
x: AP had taken about ₹4,000 crore from the UIDF (18 August 2026).

s: Which Economic Survey introduced the Bare Necessities Index (BNI)?
x: The Economic Survey 2020-21 built the Bare Necessities Index from NSO data on water, sanitation, housing, micro-environment and other facilities.

s: The 'Chakravyuha challenge' in the Economic Survey 2015-16 refers to which problem of the Indian economy?
o: Easy entry but difficult exit of firms
x: The Economic Survey 2015-16 used the Mahabharata image of the Chakravyuha: firms find it easy to enter but hard to exit.

s: Which pair of small-savings interest rates (Q1 FY27, unchanged from 1 April 2026) is correct?
x: SSY earns 8.2% and PPF 7.1%. Option B swaps them; 7.7% is the NSC rate, not PPF or SSY.

s: What interest rate on EPF deposits was fixed for 2025-26?
x: The EPF interest rate for 2025-26 was 8.25 per cent and remained unchanged.

s: Which one of the following correctly represents the EPF contribution structure?
o: 10 per cent by the employee and 12 per cent by the employer
12 per cent by the employee and 12 per cent by the employer
8.25 per cent by the employee and 8.25 per cent by the employer
12 per cent by the employee and 8.25 per cent by the employer
x: The EPF contribution remains 12 per cent from the employee and 12 per cent from the employer.

s: Who launched the 'Micro Bachat' micro-insurance plan?
x: LIC launched the 'Micro Bachat' micro-insurance plan.

s: Which of the following pairs about small-savings schemes is correctly matched?
o: Funds credited to – National Small Savings Fund (Public Account)
x: Small-savings funds go to the NSSF in the Public Account; rates are set quarterly by the Finance Ministry and linked to G-Sec yields.

s: Which small-savings scheme carries the highest rate (8.2%) in Q1 FY27?
x: Sukanya Samriddhi (8.2%) is the highest; EPF's 8.25% is not a small-savings scheme.

s:
Consider the following statements about the EPF interest rate for 2025-26:
1. It was recommended by the EPFO Central Board of Trustees.
2. It was approved by the Reserve Bank of India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct: the CBT recommended 8.25% on 2 March 2026 and the Finance Ministry approved it.

s: In which account is the National Small Savings Fund, which receives small-savings collections, kept?
x: The NSSF sits in the Public Account, not the Consolidated Fund.

s: Who sets the interest rates on small-savings schemes every quarter?
x: Small-savings rates are set quarterly by the Finance Ministry, linked to G-Sec yields.

s: What was the interest rate on Post Office savings deposits in Q1 FY27?
x: Post Office savings stayed at 4% in Q1 FY27.

s: For which subsidy is purpose-bound e₹ used in CBDC-based DBT under PM-GKAY?
x: The CBDC-based DBT arrangement under PM-GKAY uses purpose-bound digital rupees for food subsidy and is associated with Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

s: Where were the CBDC-based DBT pilots of August 2026, paying PM-GKAY subsidy as e-rupee tokens, run?
o: Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Delhi and Dadra and Nagar Haveli
x: The pilots were in Chandigarh and Dadra and Nagar Haveli, with purpose-bound e-rupee tokens.

s: Under the Draft RBI (Interest Rates on Loans and Advances) Directions, 2026, which benchmark must floating-rate personal and MSME loans use?
o: The marginal cost of funds only
The bank’s fixed prime lending rate
x: Floating-rate personal and MSME loans must use an external benchmark from 1 April 2027.

s: Where is the headquarters of the bank formed by merging four RRBs in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The merged Andhra Pradesh RRB has its headquarters at Guntur.

s: When did India's gross NPAs reach a decade-low of 2.3 per cent?
x: Gross NPAs stood at a decade-low 2.3% in March 2025.

s: Which one of the following is NOT listed as an asset-quality or financial-sector technology tool?
x: MuleHunter.ai, ULI and DPIP are listed as tools related to asset quality or financial-sector development. PaSS is a Payments Vision 2028 initiative.

s: From which date does the external-benchmark rule of the Draft RBI (Interest Rates on Loans and Advances) Directions, 2026 apply?
x: The rule for floating-rate personal and MSME loans starts on 1 April 2027, not 2026.

s: Which bank was fined by the RBI in July 2019?
x: The RBI fined the State Bank of India in July 2019.

s: In June 2026, the RBI said it was exploring a 'Kill Switch' for what?
x: The RBI was exploring a 'Kill Switch' for digital payments (2 June 2026).

s: What is the full form of ULI, a financial-sector digital tool?
x: ULI stands for Unified Lending Interface.

s: From which date was a change relating to UPI MDR expected to take effect?
x: A change relating to the UPI Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) was expected to take effect from 15 October 2026.

s: How many initiatives does the RBI's Payments Vision 2028 (April 2026) contain?
x: Payments Vision 2028 has 15 initiatives, including shared fraud liability of sender and receiver banks.

s: Which of the following is NOT part of RBI's Payments Vision 2028?
o: Shared fraud liability of sender and receiver banks
Fraud liability placed on the customer alone
x: Payments Vision 2028 (15 initiatives) makes sender and receiver banks share fraud liability; it does not put it on the customer alone.

s: What is the full form of PaSS, an initiative under RBI Payments Vision 2028?
x: PaSS is the Payments Switching Service, one of the 15 initiatives of Payments Vision 2028.

s: To what level did the RBI MPC change the repo rate on 7 October 2026?
x: The repo was hiked 25 bps to 5.50%, unanimously.

s: To which stance did the RBI change from neutral at the October 2026 policy?
x: The stance moved from neutral to "calibrated tightening" along with a repo hike.

s: Which of the following pairs (policy rate – level, October 2026) is correctly matched?
x: After October 2026: repo 5.50%, SDF 5.25%, MSF and Bank Rate 5.75%.

s: What CPI inflation did the RBI project for FY27 in October 2026?
x: In October 2026 the RBI projected FY27 CPI inflation at 5.2% and real GDP at 7.1%.

s: What real GDP growth did the RBI project for FY27 in October 2026?
x: The RBI projected FY27 real GDP growth at 7.1% in October 2026.

s: To what was the rise in CPI inflation to 4.45% (August–September 2026) mainly linked?
o: Higher oil prices linked to the West Asia situation
x: The rise in CPI to 4.45% was associated with West Asia-related oil-price pressures.

s: What is the base year of the rebased CPI series released on 12 February 2026?
x: The CPI base moved from 2012 to 2024; GDP moved to 2022-23.

s: What is the base year of the new GDP (national accounts) series released on 27 February 2026?
x: The national accounts were rebased from 2011-12 to 2022-23.

s: What was India's Q1 FY27 (April–June 2026) GDP growth, released by NSO on 31 August 2026?
x: Q1 FY27 GDP grew 7.8%; 8.2% was real GVA and 6.9% the figure a year earlier.

s: To what level did ICRA raise its FY27 growth projection for India after the Q1 FY27 data?
x: ICRA raised its FY27 projection from 6.7% to 7.1%, matching the RBI.

s: What was India's GDP growth in FY26, as per the data noted in 2026?
x: FY26 GDP growth was 7.7% as per the latest data.

s: More than 75 per cent of India's FDI inflows in April 2026 came from which group of countries?
o: China, Russia and the United States
Japan, China and the United Kingdom
x: Japan, Singapore and Mauritius together accounted for over 75 per cent of India's FDI inflows in April 2026.

s: About what was Russia's share of India's crude oil imports in June 2026?
x: Russia supplied about 48% of India's crude in June 2026, rising since the West Asia war.

s: Which institution is associated with the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) loan for Andhra Pradesh?
x: The VCIC loan is from the ADB, while the SALT loan is from the World Bank.

s: By how much did Andhra Pradesh's net GST collections grow in 2025-26?
x: AP's net GST grew 6% in 2025-26 despite a ₹4,500 crore hit from GST 2.0.

s: About how large was the GST 2.0 revenue hit to Andhra Pradesh, whose net GST still grew 6% in 2025-26?
x: AP absorbed a ₹4,500 crore GST 2.0 hit; ₹4,000 crore is what it took from UIDF.

s: Which institution gives the SALT loan to Andhra Pradesh?
x: SALT is a World Bank loan; VCIC is backed by the ADB.

s: How did Andhra Pradesh's retail inflation compare with the national rate in 2026?
x: Andhra Pradesh's retail inflation was 4.9%, above the national rate.

src: APPSC Deputy Inspector of Survey, Technical Assistant in AP
s: Which Indian company announced the launch of an e-commerce app 'OrderMe' in May 2020?
x: In May 2020 Patanjali Ayurved launched 'OrderMe', a swadeshi e-commerce app for local retailers.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Out of the following, currency note of which new denomination is recently released by RBI?
x: RBI issued the new Rs 200 note (Mahatma Gandhi New Series, Sanchi Stupa motif) in August 2017; there are no Rs 150, 250 or 300 notes.
